operator.side_effect_boundary: APPLIED and REPLAYED use status-specific runtime-scope-bound handler receipts and require the exact durable HardState event. Response loss, success=false or attribution failure after the HardState call must first reopen the exact event: an existing commit becomes REPLAYED, an uncertain read remains PENDING with RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and UNKNOWN regardless of ordinary max attempts, and only authoritative absence may enter ordinary failure.
